purpose.zh: 拉伸前腿的大腿后侧，为前后劈叉打基础
purpose.en: Stretch the back of your front thigh as a first step toward the front splits.

text.zh: 臀部往后坐，前腿伸直，背拉长
text.en: Sit your hips back, straighten the front leg and keep your back long

text.zh: 后膝跪地，前脚跟着地、勾脚尖。
text.en: Kneel on the back knee with the front heel down and toes up.

text.zh: 双手扶砖，上身往前倾，背保持平直。
text.en: Rest your hands on the blocks and lean forward with a flat back.

commonErrors.en: Rounding your back to reach the foot.

cautions.zh: 跪着的膝盖下面垫个软垫
cautions.en: Put a soft pad under the kneeling knee.

cautions.zh: 大腿后侧疼时坐得少一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If the back of your thigh hurts, sit back less, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 动画每 8 秒一次「后坐-停约 2 s-回来」，剂量从 30 秒保持改为每侧 2 组×5 次（rep_hold）
cue3「从髋部向前折」改「上身往前倾，背保持平直」
flags: 拉伸按次数：原剂量是静止计时，但动画每 8 秒做一次「进入-停住-回来」，按规则改成按次数（rep_hold，training.stretchLoop=true）；想改回计时需动画改成一直停住，请定
